text:
Type: child-size wooden rocking chair
Use: sitting, rocking, playing; kids' room, nursery, playroom
Style: farmhouse, Scandinavian, traditional
Materials: solid wood frame in a white painted finish
Colors: white
Shape: small rocker with a curved top rail, vertical slat back, flat armrests on spindles, solid seat, curved rocker runners, compact and light
Feel: sweet, simple, bright, homey
Goes with: white or pastel kids' furniture, light wood floors, soft textiles; Scandinavian or farmhouse nurseries

product.name: SUNDVIK
product.description: Rocking helps develop the child's sense of balance and the brain to sort sensory impressions.
